resources.string: Paste a page link, inspect its reported streams, then download the selected video or audio. Processing and merging happen on this device.
Reading media formats from the source...
These are source-reported formats, not invented presets. Availability is checked again when the job starts.
Video and audio will be merged into %1$s
This source has no audio track.
No usable stream for this mode. Try the other mode or the direct file downloader.
A higher encoding bitrate does not restore detail absent from the source. Source codec avoids unnecessary re-encoding when supported.
Allow unencrypted HTTP requests for this analysis/job
Media workspace limit: 8 GiB, subject to free storage. Retry restarts unpublished media transfers; finalized outputs are not duplicated. Links expire from memory after the app process ends.
The current extractor does not recognize this link. Try analyzing the original page or a detected direct media resource.
The source requires a browser session or rejected the request. Browser login cookies are not transferred to the extractor in this build.
The source rate-limited the request. Retry later without creating duplicate jobs.
The selected format changed or is unavailable. Analyze the original link again.
Enter one complete HTTP or HTTPS link.
The media runtime is not available in this build or device ABI. Build the extended-media variant described in the source README.
Media processing did not finish. No completed file has been claimed. Review the diagnostic code and retry or analyze another link.
The page could not be opened securely. This browser accepts HTTPS and does not bypass certificate failures.
No file access, native JavaScript bridge, camera or microphone access. Browser sessions remain in WebView; their login cookies are not exported to the downloader.
Detected network candidates may be previews or manifests. Analyze one to inspect actual formats; no download starts automatically.
No media resource detected yet. Start playback on the page, or use Analyze page.
Create an additional copy on the next download

Only download videos or audio you own or are allowed to save. Some sites prohibit downloading in their terms of service, and bypassing paid access, login walls, or copy protection is not supported. You are responsible for respecting copyright and the source site\'s terms.
